title: Affine-homotopy estimate |Z(η′)| ≤ c·s·L^k·M(X)·sup|ψ| (Simon 2.27; conjunct (Aff))
statement: (Aff) For all m, m′, k ∈ ℕ there is c ≥ 0 such that for all X ∈ D_k(ℝ^m), Z ∈ D_{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}), C^∞ maps F₀, F₁ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′}, open O ⊆ ℝ^m and s, L, B ∈ ℝ with 0 ≤ s, 0 ≤ L, 0 ≤ B, M(X) ≤ ofReal B, ProdChar(X, Z), spt X ⊆ O, dist(F₁(x), F₀(x)) ≤ s, ‖fderiv ℝ F₀ x‖ ≤ L and ‖fderiv ℝ F₁ x‖ ≤ L for x ∈ O, and F₀⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for every compact K: for every ψ ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m′}), every C ∈ ℝ with covectorEuclideanNorm (ψ(y)) ≤ C for all y, and every η′ ∈ D^{k+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) compatible near cyl(spt X) with (G, ψ) — i.e. there is an open N ⊇ cyl(spt X) with η′(y) = ψ(G(y)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ G y) for all y ∈ N — where G(y) := F₀(tl(y)) + t(y)·(F₁(tl(y)) − F₀(tl(y))), one has |Z(η′)| ≤ c·s·L^k·B·C. This is verbatim the third conjunct of the selected parent dph_smooth_homotopy. Notation: ℝ^p := Eucl p = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p). For s ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m, cons(s, x) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ x)) ∈ ℝ^{m+1}; ι(v) := cons(0, v); e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{m+1}; for y ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, t(y) := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y 0 and tl(y) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ y)); cyl(A) := {y : t(y) ∈ [0,1] ∧ tl(y) ∈ A}. D_q(ℝ^p) := GeometricCurrentOn univ q, D^q(ℝ^p) := TestFormOn univ q, M = mass, spt = support, |γ| := covectorEuclideanNorm γ. For X ∈ D_q(ℝ^m) and Z ∈ D_{q+1}(ℝ^{m+1}), ProdChar(X, Z) means: for every η ∈ D^{q+1}(ℝ^{m+1}) and every φ : ℝ → D^q(ℝ^m) with φ(s)(x)(v) = η(cons(s, x))(Fin.cons e₀ (i ↦ ι(v_i))) for all s ∈ [0,1], x ∈ ℝ^m and v : Fin q → ℝ^m, one has Z(η) = ∫_0^1 X(φ(s)) ds (interval integral).
